title: pteroselinum austriacum var. leptophyllum
intro: Pteroselinum austriacum var. leptophyllum, commonly known as Wild Angelica, is a perennial herb belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Wild Angelica include its ability to ease digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
